tool_input.command: for f in index.html pigment.app.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/components/*.tsx src/pages/*.tsx src/styles/base.css tests/smoke.spec.ts; do echo "=== $f"; cat "$f"; done

git add -A && git commit -q -m "Add margin-notes tokens, fonts, studio filters and restyled shell

Copies tokens.css verbatim, rebuilds base.css on semantic tokens with legacy
aliases, loads Geist/Geist Mono/Caveat, adds the shared filter SVG, toast stack,
studio detail components, sidebar note and mobile section sheet.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>" && git log --oneline | head -2

cd src/pages && sed -i \
 -e 's|strokeWidth="2"|strokeWidth="1.5"|' \
 -e 's|className="field-error" data-testid="error-name">|className="field-error" data-testid="error-name">
                <AlertIcon />|' \
 -e 's|className="field-error" data-testid="error-email">|className="field-error" data-testid="error-email">
                <AlertIcon />|' \
 -e 's|className="field-error" data-testid="error-timezone">|className="field-error" data-testid="error-timezone">
                <AlertIcon />|' \
 -e 's|className="field-error" data-testid="error-bio">|className="field-error" data-testid="error-bio">
                <AlertIcon />|' \
 -e 's|<div className="form-actions">|<div className="form-actions action-bar">|' \
 -e "s|{saved ? 'Saved' : ''}|{saved \&\& (
              <>
                <CheckIcon size={12} />
                Saved
              </>
            )}|" \
 ProfilePage.tsx && grep -n "AlertIcon\|CheckIcon\|action-bar\|1.5" ProfilePage.tsx
tool_input.description: Apply icon, error and status edits to Profile page
Re-snap all pages and the not-found page
